name: Netorase Onsen Ryokou 2 ~Fukanshou Kyouiku Mama wa Yarite no Chounai Kaichou ni Shitai no Seikantai o Oshiekomareta~
original_name: 寝取らせ温泉旅行2 ～不感症教育ママはヤリ手の町内会長に肢体の性感帯を教え込まれた～
source:
Kazuha Oba is a devoted mother who places her son's education above everything else.

Because sex had always been painful, she regarded intimacy as nothing more than a means of having a child. After giving birth to her son, Yu, she steadfastly avoided any physical relationship with her husband, Sosuke.

One day, she is invited to join a preliminary inspection for a hot spring trip organized by the neighborhood association for its elderly members.

What she does not know is that Sosuke and the neighborhood chairman, Masahiko, have already made a secret agreement behind her back.

During the trip, Kazuha experiences intimacy without pain for the very first time... and slowly begins to transform into someone driven by newfound passion.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4906010/NTR_Onsen_Trip2/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
大庭和叶是一位一心扑在儿子学业上的教育妈妈。

由于性事对她而言向来伴随着疼痛，她一直将房事仅仅视作生育的手段。在生下儿子小优之后，她便坚决拒绝与丈夫聪介发生任何肉体关系。

某天，町内会计划组织面向高龄居民的温泉旅行，和叶受邀一同前往实地踩点考察。

然而她并不知道，聪介与町内会会长雅彦早已背着她达成了一项秘密协议。

在这次旅途中，和叶生平第一次体会到了没有痛楚的欢愉……并逐渐蜕变为被全新情欲所驱使的女人。
